_readme: Curated heritage / panorama catalogue (UNSOLVED-GAPS 1.2, the non-algorithmic two-thirds). HAND-EDITED source of truth; tools/build-heritage.py resolves stop names to UIC ids, validates, and writes the HERITAGE_CATALOGUE constant into app.js. Evidence per product: 'operator' = the season is quoted from the operator's own page (URL in source, wording in quote); 'third-party' = only aggregators were reachable at check time and the card SAYS so. Seasons change yearly: re-check every product before the next timetable year and bump 'checked'.

products.name: Glacier Express

season.note: winter timetable resumes; end date not stated on the page

products.quote: Summer timetable 02.05.2026 – 10.10.2026. The Glacier Express will not be running between 11.10. and 04.12.2026. A seat reservation is mandatory.
products.note: Runs as a regular train in the timetable but with its own product and mandatory reservation; not filterable from stationboard data.

products.name: Bernina Express
products.quote: Operator page states reservation and a diversion via Vereina (Chur – Landquart – Klosters – Sagliains – Pontresina) from Thursday 29 October to Friday 13 November 2026; it does not state the season. Third-party (seat61, myswissalps, 2026-09-08): runs daily all year, summer timetable 2 May – 25 October 2026.
products.note: Intermediate stops are not listed on the operator page; only the three named ones are carried. 29.10.–13.11.2026: trains 951/952 diverted via Vereina, no Albula line.

products.name: Historical train (1920s stock, open scenic carriage)
products.quote: From 14 May to 25 October 2026, you will have the opportunity to travel daily on a historical train composition from the 1920s from Davos to Filisur and back.
products.note: Not barrier-free (nostalgic coaches). Stops per the open-scenic-carriages page.

products.name: Open scenic carriages on the Bernina line
products.quote: Bernina Line: daily from 22 June to 30 August 2026. Reservations are not possible for single travellers.
products.note: Carried on ordinary regional trains, so the timetable shows nothing special.

products.name: Viaduct shuttle with open scenic carriages
products.quote: Viaduct Shuttle: Wednesday to Sunday from 14 May to 28 June 2026, daily from 29 June to 30 August 2026 and Wednesday to Sunday from 2 September to 25 October 2026.

products.name: Landwasser Express (tourist train to the viaduct viewpoint)
products.route: Filisur station – Landwasser viaduct vantage point
products.quote: Charter trips are available daily from 14 May to 18 October.
products.note: Not a railway timetable train at all – a 54-seat road-going tourist train from the station forecourt; the page states charter availability, not public departures.

products.name: Gotthard Panorama Express (boat + panorama train)
products.quote: Von Samstag, 18. April 2026 bis Sonntag, 18. Oktober 2026 täglich. Obligatorische Reservation.
products.note: 1st-class panorama train over the Gotthard mountain line; the boat leg is Luzern – Flüelen.

products.name: Furka steam railway (Dampfbahn Furka-Bergstrecke)
products.route: Realp DFB – Furka DFB – Gletsch – Oberwald
products.quote: Operator page: service between Realp, Gletsch and Oberwald; seat reservation is part of the offer; tickets to or from Tiefenbach DFB, Furka DFB and Muttbach-Belvédère only at a staffed ticket office. Season NOT stated on that page. Third-party (dampfundschiene.de, 2026-09-08): Thursday to Sunday, 18 June – 27 September 2026.
products.note: Official timetable table 615 (FAHRPLANJAHR 2026) exists at widgets.oev-info.ch but could not be read on this box.

products.name: Blonay–Chamby museum railway
products.quote: THE MUSEUM IS OPEN EVERY SATURDAY AND SUNDAY FROM MAY 2 TO OCTOBER 25. 2026
products.note: Traction (steam or electric) is not stated on the operator page and is reserved to change; a 2026 search summary reported electric-only under fire risk – unverified.

products.name: Sursee–Triengen public steam train
products.quote: Operator site unreachable from the curating box (timed out three times 2026-09-08). Third-party search summary: last Sunday of each month May–October 2026 – 31.5., 28.6., 26.7., 30.8., 27.9., 25.10.; no advance reservation, tickets on board.
products.note: Geuensee, Büron and Triengen have no rail station in transport.opendata.ch (bus stops only), so this product is findable at Sursee only.
